description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only (Bailiff demo, step 3): appeal the return order with optional reasons (up to 1,000 characters). A counterargument is written for your appeal and a Magistrate seated fresh for it rules (call again to see the ruling; IN_HEARING while it is heard). The Magistrate reads both sides and writes its own ruling. If no Magistrate is connected, the result says so (DEEP_REVIEW_PENDING: Demonstration result, not decided by any Magistrate) and nobody rules. The order stays in force during the appeal. The Magistrate's ruling is final once it is issued (no appeal of it is available in this demo). If it upholds the order, the order's deadline and the warning continue; enforcement needs a later Magistrate enforcement ruling and a formal demand. One appeal per copy. Demonstration on a synthetic practice matter; not certified; binds only this practice copy.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.
